description: Source code for the cSettings class, which manages reading, writing, and manipulating configuration settings stored in a file, including methods for setting, getting, checking, and removing key-value pairs.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: A class that handles configuration settings stored in a file, providing methods to read, write, and manage key-value pairs.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a filename and reads data from the file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from the specified file into the internal data structure.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes the current configuration data to the file.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the configuration data, overloaded for string, int, and bool values.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and has a non-empty value.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the configuration data.
